task_detail.downstream_eval: intrinsic: word similarity on WS-353, SimLex-999, MEN, MTurk-287, MTurk-771, RG-65 (Spearman, Kendall, cosine vs human scores) and word categorization on AP, BLESS, ESSLLI (KMeans purity); extrinsic: embeddings as input to an attention BiLSTM on R8, R52, TREC, SUBJ, SST-2, SST-5 (accuracy, macro-F1)

preprocessing.params: each document represented as the set of its words D subset of V (e.g. 'The actor was brilliant' -> {actor, brilliant, the, was}); tokenizer, casing and stop-word handling not stated
target vocabulary V of m unique words; size m not stated; the One Billion Word vocabulary covers about 80% of the vocabulary needed by the downstream classification tasks

Algorithm 1: per round and target word, random target q_k in {0,1} (balances the data), u=25 random documents with (q=1) or without (q=0) the word are ORed into one example; r=2000 rounds -> 2000 examples per word

booleanization.description: Each vocabulary word is a propositional variable that is 1 if it occurs in the (ORed union of u=25) documents and 0 otherwise; the autoencoder uses no negated literals, and the target word's own input is masked (set to 1) and frozen.

notes: All 120 record values checked against Tables 1-3: no mismatches. Embedding dimension (600) is inferred from the clause count; the TM is a Coalesced TM with a shared pool of n=600 clauses, so clauses_scope='total'. Training length is r=2000 rounds of Algorithm 1 (one example per word per round, u=25 ORed documents), not epochs. Number of TA states not stated (Fig. 2 shows 4 positions only as illustration). Vocabulary size m and its selection are not stated, only that One Billion Word covers ~80% of the downstream vocabulary. Classification n_classes/label_type are not stated in the paper (record uses standard values) and splits are only 'standard SentEval datasets'. Intrinsic usages are typed representation_learning (embedding evaluation); categorization uses KMeans purity with an unstated number of clusters. No run counts, seeds or variance are given for any table, so statistic/n_runs are not_reported. Record category 'generative_sequence' fits poorly: the paper is representation learning.
